## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: flagged_for_deep_analysis is set from the corresponding Noul with a...

The system SHALL ensure that flagged_for_deep_analysis is set from the corresponding Noul with a config-held threshold; the weighted sum and its 5/10 buckets remain as the fallback and are exercised by a test.

#### Scenario: flagged_for_deep_analysis is set from the corresponding Noul with a...

WHEN `judge-transcript-struggle-triage-in-collect-transcripts` is implemented
THEN flagged_for_deep_analysis is set from the corresponding Noul with a config-held threshold; the weighted sum and its 5/10 buckets remain as the fallback and are exercised by a test.

### Requirement: State sent for triage contains only assistant/user/tool-result text from...

The system SHALL ensure that state sent for triage contains only assistant/user/tool-result text from normalize.py's compact event form, with a test asserting tool payloads are excluded and the state stays under the token budget.

#### Scenario: State sent for triage contains only assistant/user/tool-result text from...

WHEN `judge-transcript-struggle-triage-in-collect-transcripts` is implemented
THEN State sent for triage contains only assistant/user/tool-result text from normalize.py's compact event form, with a test asserting tool payloads are excluded and the state stays under the token budget.

### Requirement: The four counters are still computed deterministically and appear unchanged...

The system SHALL ensure that the four counters are still computed deterministically and appear unchanged in the triage output schema.

#### Scenario: The four counters are still computed deterministically and appear unchanged...

WHEN `judge-transcript-struggle-triage-in-collect-transcripts` is implemented
THEN The four counters are still computed deterministically and appear unchanged in the triage output schema.

### Requirement: Existing collect-transcripts triage tests pass with the helper stubbed to None

The system SHALL ensure that existing collect-transcripts triage tests pass with the helper stubbed to None.

#### Scenario: Existing collect-transcripts triage tests pass with the helper stubbed to None

WHEN `judge-transcript-struggle-triage-in-collect-transcripts` is implemented
THEN Existing collect-transcripts triage tests pass with the helper stubbed to None.
